proposal.cash_flow_convention: end-year spending/additional fee deductions measured against beginning-year NAV: 1+R-s-f=(1+i)*(1+g)
proposal.target_note: Planning hurdle, not a forecast; total-return adjusted ETF data already embed fund expenses. Additional0.25% fee is separate hypothetical mandate cost, not a second fund expense.
proposal.rationale: Illustrative conservative review budgets chosen before current/evaluation results. At USD10M these are USD100k VaR95,USD150k VaR99,USD200k ES99; 20% loss triggers mandate adjustment discussion. They are not organiser/client-supplied requirements.
proposal.decision_policy: Conditional ADJUST: retain eligible universe and constrained rule as candidate; do not accept until spending/return feasibility, approved loss budgets, concentration and human review are resolved. Do not relax budgets merely to pass.

monitoring.action: Escalate to committee and assess feasible redistribution; no automatic cap relaxation.
Flag drift; review at scheduled monthly rebalance, no unapproved daily clipping.
Statistical p-value below0.05 triggers model/dependence review, not proof of future loss.
